evidence:
Product scope: the public brief asks for time-varying, interaction-preserving behaviour (instruction.md:5 'Other people's moves should show up on my board within fifteen seconds without a reload, and without closing the card I have open, wiping the note I am typing or moving my cursor'; :7 scrolled-up arrival, drafts, unread, seen; hireops_rules.md:117-123 updates within 15 s with nothing clicked, preserving typed text, focus, open card, open conversation and scroll). It explicitly excludes theming and responsive layouts (instruction.md:11 'A clear desktop workspace is what matters. We don't need theme switching or a special phone layout.'), and there is no required animation. So resize/toggle legs are correctly N-A; the visual judge is told 'Assess desktop craft at a conventional desktop viewport. No phone layout or theme switching is required.' (scored/visual/prompt.md:14), which matches the brief and is not a still-paint shortcut for a required behaviour.

Every interactive/time-varying requirement is graded by an acting-and-waiting judge, not a first paint:
- Wait without interaction: functional prompt.md:47 (V) 'Without reloading or clicking in this page, wait up to 15 seconds (a wait-for call, or snapshots; accept what is present at the first snapshot at or after 15 seconds)' -> hro_live_board (functional judge.toml:284-291). prompt.md:41 (U) 'Every reading in U is made without reloading, navigating or clicking in Rafael's page: wait up to 15 seconds after the other person acts' -> hro_unread_counts (:329-336), hro_seen (:347-354), hro_unread_scrolled_up (:338-345). T 'watch the reply arrive on Rafael's open conversation without reload' -> hro_msg_exchange (:293-300). Each change is driven by a different account in an independent browser context, so the arrival is genuinely time-varying.
- Preservation during updates: polish judge.toml:17-24 hro_pol_live_board (open card details, type an unfinished note, scroll the page or board container, other recruiter moves a card, then check details open, note value, document.activeElement, scroll not reset, typing appends); :26-33 hro_pol_live_thread (draft/focus preserved, view at newest); polish prompt.md:14 'After that action do not reload, navigate, click or type in the observed page until the update has been seen or 15 seconds have passed. Read document.activeElement, field values and scroll offsets with page.evaluate'.
- Scroll behaviour: hro_pol_earlier_place (polish :35-42) measures getBoundingClientRect().top before/after loading earlier messages; hro_unread_scrolled_up requires scrolling up then reading place/notice/unread before and after; hro_thread_latest requires 'scrolled to the newest'.
- Keyboard/focus interactions: hro_msg_compose (Shift+Enter/Enter, box empty and focused), hro_refused_put_back (focus via document.activeElement after refused move), hro_pol_failed_send (abort one send / setOffline), hro_pol_session_resume (sign-out in second tab then press Send in the first page), hro_drafts (switch conversation/Board, reload).
Render gate deliberately judges only sign-in and first render (gates/render/prompt.md:9), which is correct for a gate; behaviour is scored elsewhere.

Feasibility/control: the scripted golden (qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/results/workspace.json, hash-verified, sources matching the frozen solution) shows these behaviours are observable in a browser: live board arrival_ms 805 with open card, note draft and focus kept; scrolled-up arrival keeps scrollTop and draft/focus and shows '1 new message'; seen receipt and unread badges update live (workspace.cjs ~345-434). This is scripted Playwright, not a configured judge run.

Broken app that could pass? (a) Updates only on window focus/visibilitychange or on next click: judge is forbidden to click/navigate and must wait 15 s in the observed page -> fails hro_live_board/hro_unread_counts. (b) Poll every 30-60 s: first snapshot at/after 15 s shows nothing -> fails. (c) Full re-render on each update that wipes the note/focus/scroll: caught by page.evaluate reads in hro_pol_live_board/hro_pol_live_thread. (d) Scroll jump on arrival or on load-earlier: caught by scroll/rect measurements. None slips through on a still paint. Conforming alternative that could fail? SSE, sockets or polling <=15 s all pass (rules:123 allows all three; criteria never mandate a transport); a board with no page scroll is handled ('or record that no scroll exists and judge the other legs'); a non-scrolling-page layout using an inner container is explicitly allowed. A drag-only UI is legitimately excluded by the brief ('every move has to work with ordinary controls'). No hidden viewport, theme or animation demand was found.

Risk: no full configured judge run (claude-code with the task.toml model) exists in the evidence index ('Full configured grading/workload ... are absent'), so it is unmeasured whether the judge actually performs the 15 s waits/scroll/focus probes inside the very long functional protocol (timeout 9000) rather than skipping or snapshotting early. The prompts tell it to; whether it does is NOT EXERCISED. Out-of-row observation for the owner (not scored here): the 15 s/no-reload bar for unread counts and seen marks rests on hireops_rules.md:117-119, not on instruction.md itself; it is public via the referenced rules file.
